title: Brother Took $145K Retirement, Promised Heart Meds, Then Cut Me Off. So I Took Back Pharmacy.
description: I emptied my $145K retirement fund to buy my brother a pharmacy, trusting his promise of lifelong free heart medication. Instead, he sold my patient list and stopped filling my prescriptions. Then I found a digital recording of him bragging about the entire scam. Now he counts tablets in a lab coat that says ‘Overdosed on Lies’ at Pill of Perjury Apothecary. #FamilyBetrayal #RevengeStory #Karma
thumb_text: HE COUNTS PILLS IN A OVERDOSED ON LIES LAB COAT
pinned_comment: If your own brother drained your $145K retirement, promised you lifelong heart meds, and then sold your patient list, what would you have done? Share your story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: FATHER'S HIDDEN USB WARNED ME HE WAS A SCAM
